_comment: Idiom extraction + Korean translation go through this list, in order. A video is processed by ONE model start to finish; if that model is blocked, the video restarts from the beginning on the next one. Order chosen 2026-10-18 from real runs: mistral-large-3 (served by xkiro) answers a batch in ~15 s and writes short outputs; gpt-oss-120b is a reasoning model (~20k output tokens per video) behind Groq's per-minute/day token limits and a slower OVH route; gemma-4-31b-it needs the router's PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_GOOGLE raised; the paid Gemini key needs credits. No API keys in this file - only the paths of the files that hold them (outside the repository).
